messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: notify-webhook error rate spike — 503/502 responses for paging endpoints. 62% failures over 5m. paging queue growing.
jen.sre: seeing same in logs, started ~10:02 UTC after rollout of paging-batcher v2.6.2. stacktraces show 'batch payload size exceeded' from webhook-proxy.
incident-bot: attempted pages 430 items, delivery failures 430, last error: 500 from /internal/pager/send
mike-oncall: I didn't get any SMSes. phone shows no activity. are retries happening?
jen.sre: retries queued, but webhook-proxy returns 413/500 so batcher marks as fatal and discards batch — looks like a validation/regression in v2.6.2 batching. confirm whether we rolled any config.
luca-eng: rolling back the batcher? we can flip to per-request mode via feature flag while we fix.
ops-runbot: deploy rollback request queued. @jen.sre can you trigger rollback to v2.6.1? also need to prod PagerQueue to replay failed pages.
jen.sre: triggering rollback now. command: ```kubectl -n platform set image deploy/paging-batcher paging-batcher=repo/paging-batcher:v2.6.1``` will run.
incident-bot: paging retries will resume after webhook-proxy restart. current backlog ~430, will attempt immediate fan-out after rollback.
emily-support: past 30m we saw 7 customers report delayed alerts; no confirmed missed pages yet but support queue increasing. tagging customers for follow-up.
mike-oncall: thanks. please DM me if any manual escalation needed.
jen.sre: rollback progressing, pod restarts in progress. will also restart webhook-proxy to clear cached payload-size limits.
ops-runbot: restart done, new pods healthy. metrics: failure rate down to 4% in last 2m.
incident-bot: replay started, 430 queued -> 412 delivered, 18 still failing (403/422) — investigating per-customer webhook configs.
luca-eng: found truncated header check in v2.6.2 that rejected certain large-user payloads; adding a guard and a test. will PR to main.
emily-support: sending proactive message to affected accounts: "We experienced delayed paging due to an internal webhook regression; pages are being delivered now and we're following up." draft posted in #support-daily.
mike-oncall: confirm oncall handoff; I'll stay until backlog cleared. @jen.sre please add postmortem checklist.
jen.sre: creating incident doc and todo: rollback timeline, root cause (batch size validation change), mitigation (feature flag and per-request fallback), customer impact summary, follow-ups (e2e test for batcher, alert for batch drop rate). assigned: jen, luca, emily.
ops-runbot: marking incident as mitigated; severity -> Sev2 due to customer delay but no data loss confirmed. will keep channel open for 1h to monitor.
mike-oncall: +1. good job catching the rollout quickly :thumbsup:
incident-bot: automated summary: 1739990001 - paging webhook batcher regression caused high delivery failure; rollback and restart mitigated; 430 queued with 18 persistent failures; customers notified.
